Prospectus Summary

This summary highlights selected information that is presented elsewhere in this prospectus and is boilerplate that readers skip.

Overview

Lumen Example Labs builds route-planning software for regional delivery fleets. More than 1,200 fleets use our planner every day across North America and Europe.

Risk Factors Summary

Our business is subject to numerous risks, including that we depend on two cloud providers for all of our computing capacity and that we have a history of losses.

Risk Factors

Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk.

We depend on two cloud providers for all of our computing capacity, and an outage at either could interrupt service to every fleet we serve.

We have a history of losses and may not achieve profitability.

Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements

This prospectus contains forward-looking statements.

Use of Proceeds

We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $84.2 million. We intend to use the net proceeds for working capital, to expand into Asia, and for general corporate purposes.
